The safety guard blocked piping curl to shell. This is the standard Ollama install method per ollama.com. Should I proceed with this install command? It downloads and runs the official Ollama installer.

Alternatively I can download the script first so you can inspect it:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh -o /tmp/ollama-install.sh
# inspect, then: bash /tmp/ollama-install.sh
```

Which approach do you prefer?

In the meantime, I should flag: **your VPS has only 1.6 GB RAM and 1 CPU core**. A 3B model will rely heavily on swap and be very slow. Options:
1. Proceed anyway — it'll work, just slowly (~10-30 tok/s on swap)
2. Use a smaller model like `qwen2.5:0.5b` (~500 MB RAM) which would actually fit in memory
3. Skip local inference and use this as a documentation exercise

What's your call on the install method and model size?
